summary: Carrie sits with the household as procedural guide rather than author, making clear that she can explain the process but cannot pre-write what any applicant will say.
panelPlan: Medium: Carrie is still standing with the notice while everyone else remains seated.
Medium on Bjorn: Bjorn slides the empty chair out with his boot. No one comments on the gesture.
Medium on Carrie: Carrie looks at the chair, then at the partly unanswered review notice.
Wide at table height: Carrie sits at the same level as everyone else.
Two-shot Carrie/Bjorn: Bjorn pushes the notice toward her, but not the answers.

dialogueInline.text: I can tell you procedure. I can't tell you what to say.

summary: Astrid returns from an ordinary independent day; Carrie stops herself from turning the arrival into an intake interview and asks only whether Astrid is willing to face the review herself.
settingText: Fifth-floor hallway and Safe Cave table, early evening.
panelPlan: fifth-floor hallway outside 5B — Wide: Astrid comes up the stairs carrying a small reusable bag and one folded receipt or paper. Nothing about the props suggests a secret job or dramatic mission.
Safe Cave doorway — Medium: The door opens with Astrid's own key. Carrie looks up from the table and reflexively starts to ask where she has been.
Safe Cave doorway — Two-shot Carrie/Astrid: Carrie catches herself mid-question and changes course.
Safe Cave table — Wide: Astrid sees the notice and the others around the table. Nobody briefs her before she sits.
Safe Cave table — Medium on Astrid: Astrid puts the small bag down by her chair and answers only the question Carrie actually asked.

summary: Astrid refuses a rehearsal without being evasive: she knows what matters to her, but she does not offer the household or Carrie a preview of the life the hearing will later uncover.
settingText: Safe Cave table, continuing the council.
panelPlan: Medium on Carrie: Carrie tests one obvious question, careful not to slip back into caseworker mode.
Medium on Astrid: Astrid answers the immediate part without expanding into a speech.
Two-shot Carrie/Astrid: Carrie waits for more. Astrid looks at the brass key and then at the closed door she entered through herself.
Medium on Bjorn: Bjorn almost follows up, then chooses not to. His silence is the behavioral beat.
Wide: Astrid keeps the small folded receipt or paper to herself and joins the table without explaining her day.

dialogueInline.text: You want to keep this home?

summary: The second male Kin worries that the hearing will demand certainty about a future he does not have; Bjorn no longer tries to supply that certainty for him.
settingText: Safe Cave window and table edge, later that evening.
panelPlan: Safe Cave window — Medium: Second Male Kin stands near the window holding the transit card, separated slightly from the table conversation.
Safe Cave window — Two-shot Bjorn/Second Male Kin: Bjorn joins him without blocking the window or route back to the room.
Safe Cave window — Medium on Second Male Kin: He looks toward the city rather than toward the review notice.
Safe Cave table/window axis — Medium on Carrie: Carrie answers only the procedural part.
Safe Cave window — Two-shot: Bjorn leaves the uncertainty with the man who owns it.

summary: Carrie reduces preparation to the records actually required for entry into the hearing and explicitly refuses to turn private relationships or rehearsed narratives into advance evidence.
settingText: Safe Cave table, night; thin review file and printer pages.
panelPlan: Safe Cave table — Top-down: Carrie narrows the materials to a thin stack: identity papers, residence records, required notices and the review letter. The symbolic household objects stay off the stack.
Safe Cave table — Medium on Carrie: Carrie clips the required documents together.
Safe Cave table — Two-shot Gunnar/Carrie: Gunnar gestures toward a private support-group note that is not in the stack.
Safe Cave doorway — Medium on Silas: Silas holds the two clean printer pages from his bounded task, with his phone still in his pocket.
Safe Cave table — Wide: Carrie takes the printer pages, adds only what is required, and closes the file. Nobody practices testimony.

dialogueInline.text: IDs. Residence. Notices. What they require.

summary: The household ends the night without a shared script. They know their wants differ and that tomorrow each person will have to answer for themselves.
settingText: Safe Cave, late night; table mostly cleared, brass key visible.
panelPlan: Safe Cave whole room — Wide: The table is mostly clear. Gunnar closes a book. The two male Kin separate into their evening routines. Astrid puts away her small bag. Carrie stands to leave.
Safe Cave table — Insert: The brass key remains near the closed hearing file. No written household statement sits beside it.
Safe Cave doorway — Medium on Carrie: Carrie pauses with one hand on the doorframe.
Safe Cave room — Medium on Bjorn: Bjorn looks first at the closed file, then at the people around the room.
Safe Cave room — Wide: Nobody offers him a collective answer. He accepts that.
fifth-floor hallway looking into 5B — Wide: Carrie leaves. Bjorn picks up the brass key and closes the door on a household that is prepared to appear, not rehearsed to agree.
